profile.name: sibir-adult-proportion-study
profile.description: Proposed adult male proportion profile for the existing humanoid rig. B = 0.373 m at reference stature; joint centers are design landmarks.

scope: One offline articulated mannequin study. Explicit grip and footwear shape proxies. The exact real-world length-and-balance matched three-beat reference remains to be supplied. The motion is manually authored, using prior walk capture for the foot and body cycle.
mass_model_note: The lever comparison uses the same assumed mass distribution in old and new poses. Values are lengths, not measured forces.

item_profile.basis: X runs from grip toward head, Y is thickness, Z is toward the blade edge
